# MusicMix runtime map: Windows to Linux

Sources inspected (read-only): the `*.dist-info` folders in the original checkout's
`.cache/*` and `runs/result_swarm_v12/agents/*/runtime*`, the global Windows
`Python311\Lib\site-packages` and the per-user `%APPDATA%\Python\Python311\site-packages`,
`configs/optional_runtime_inventory.json`, `.cache/pretrained_v10_windows_rerun.json`,
`docs/history/23_MODELLI_PREADDESTRATI_V10.md`, `tools/*.py` and `src/musicmix/*.py`.
All line numbers below refer to this worktree (`musicmix_cloud`), unless a path starts with `.cache/`
(the original checkout, which is not tracked by git).

## 0. Interpreter and venv layout

| Item | Windows | Linux plan |
|---|---|---|
| Python | CPython 3.11.9 (`AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python311`); every runtime folder is a `pip --target` dir or a `--system-site-packages` venv on top of it. LinkSeg and All-In-One ran under WSL with uv CPython 3.11.17 (`.cache/wsl_runtime`). | `uv venv --python 3.11`. Do not use the system 3.12, because `dgl==1.1.1` has no cp312 wheel. |
| Shared base | torch 2.14.0+cpu, numpy 2.4.6, scipy 1.17.1, pytest 9.1.1, pillow 12.3.0, transformers 5.3.0.dev0 (global, unused by the pipeline). Per-user site: matplotlib 3.11.1. | `/opt/musicmix/venv` = `env/requirements-core.txt` (+ `requirements-critics.txt` section A) |
| numpy-1 island | `.cache/cue_runtime/numpy126` (numpy 1.26.4) + `.cache/cue_runtime/site-packages` (transformers 4.42.3, tokenizers 0.19.1, hf_hub 0.36.2, timm 1.0.7, torchvision 0.29.0+cpu, librosa 0.10.2.post1), prepended to `sys.path` | `/opt/musicmix/venv-legacy` = `env/requirements-legacy-np1.txt` (CUE-DETR + SongEval/MuQ) |

**Hard conflict (this is why there are two venvs):** `transformers==4.42.3` declares `numpy<2.0`, `tokenizers<0.20`
and `huggingface-hub<1.0`. The faster-whisper stack was run with numpy 2.4.6, tokenizers 0.23.3 and
huggingface_hub 2.2.0. Both CUE-DETR (whose upstream pins transformers 4.42.3) and MuQ (`muq/modules/flash_conformer.py`
imports `transformers.deepspeed`, which newer transformers releases removed) need the old stack.
Everything else fits in one venv.

## 3. Weights and sources to stage on Linux (none are in git; `.gitignore` excludes `.cache/`, `runs/`, `*.pt`, `*.ckpt`, `*.safetensors`)

Required for the core pipeline: `beat_this-small0.ckpt` (8 MB), `955717e8-8726e21a.th` (80 MB, **lives outside the project**),
faster-whisper small.en (464 MB) and base.en (141 MB), cue-detr checkpoint (159 MB) plus `facebook/detr-resnet-50` preprocessor config,
`cue_detr_upstream` (0.1 MB), LinkSeg source and `model_7_classes.pt` (1.5 MB), `ssmnet_v12/{source,tools,weights}` (1.5 MB).
Optional critics: audiobox (396 MB), MuQ-large-msd-iter (1.27 GB) and `songeval-model.safetensors` (100 MB).
Do **not** copy any `*_runtime` / `numpy126` / `site-packages` / `Lib` / `Scripts` / `bin/*.exe` folders. They contain only win_amd64 binaries.
The exception is `.cache/linkseg_runtime/Linux/venv`, which is Linux but tied to WSL paths and should also not be reused.

## 4. Blockers and risks (ordered)

- **B1. Absolute Windows paths in frozen run JSONs.** On Linux, `pathlib` treats `C:\...` as a relative file name, so the lookup fails with a silent "file not found". The fix needs a path-translation helper, for example mapping the prefix `<workspace>\` to the repo root, applied wherever `canonical_path`/`source_path`/`*_path` is read. Rewriting the frozen JSONs would break their sha256 provenance chains.
- **B2. Canonical audio identity versus the ffmpeg version.** Windows decoded with ffmpeg 9.0 (gyan.dev) and Ubuntu apt has 6.1. Re-decoding may change `track_id`, and the tools refuse to continue when it does. Ship the canonical WAVs (and the Demucs stems) instead of regenerating them, or install a static ffmpeg 9.0.
- **B3. Two venvs required.** CUE-DETR and SongEval/MuQ need `venv-legacy` (numpy 1.26.4 / transformers 4.42.3). Everything else uses `/opt/musicmix/venv`. TenseMusic would need a third venv (TF 2.15), but it is not used by the pipeline.
- **B4. torch/torchaudio pair.** Windows ran torch 2.14.0+cpu with torchaudio 2.11.0, whose compiled `libtorchaudio` targets torch 2.11. Only `torchaudio.functional.resample` and the mel transforms (pure Python) are used. If `import torchaudio` fails against torch 2.14 on Linux, use a matched pair (e.g. torch 2.11.0 + torchaudio 2.11.0) and record the change in provenance.
- **B5. dgl 1.1.1 with torch 2.14.** It has only been validated with torch 2.9.1 (WSL). It needs Python 3.11 and `setuptools<81` (`pkg_resources`). The fallback is a dedicated LinkSeg venv with torch 2.9.1+cpu, numpy 2.2.6 and librosa 0.11.0, which exactly reproduces the WSL run.
- **B6. Implicit network fetches.** `facebook/detr-resnet-50` (`run_cue_detr.py:331`), Demucs `get_model('htdemucs')` when `$TORCH_HOME/hub/checkpoints` is empty, and `align_vocal_context.py:26` (a model name rather than a path). Pre-stage them and set `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1` / `TORCH_HOME`.
- **B7. Front-inserted Windows runtime paths.** `aesthetic_critic.py:44`, `vocal_boundaries.py:534-546`, `run_cue_detr.py:29-31` and `run_pretrained_music_critic.py:31-40` use `sys.path.insert(0, ...)`. If the Windows `.cache/*_runtime` folders are ever restored onto the Linux machine (for example inside a data bundle), they would shadow the venv and fail on `.pyd` imports. Exclude them from `cloud/build_data_bundle.py`.
